pr_title: Merge Multiple Playlists with Select Multiple Playlists Capability
pr_comment: In regards to merging remote playlists: #9191

UI feedback:
- The Select button looks a little weird and isolated up there. Is this following Material Design guidelines? Is there an icon that could serve this function? Same for the other buttons. The Delete icon is well known, of course. Maybe there is an icon that could indicate merging?
- "Cannot merge someone else's playlist" reads a bit strange. Could be "Only locally created playlists can be merged".
- "Merge no delete" is also strange to read. Instead of saying "This will delete all selected playlists." you could say "You can choose whether or not to delete the original playlists after merging.". Then the buttons could just be "Merge" and "Merge and Delete".
- The toasts after the two different kinds of merge could be different. "Playlists merged" and "Playlists merged and deleted".
- The "deleted" toast needs the first letter capitalised.

Suggest:
Merge no delete default (right button).
Would be a shame if ppl. accidentally delete their playlist
Thanks! Could you update the description video?
2, and it follows more the common UI/UX principles in my opinion.
@u7288107 Thanks for your amazing PR! However, the team members recommend to implement #3444. If you have spare time, please consider implementing #3444 instead.

review_comment: You should not do this in a blocking way. Use RxJava
The `size>=2` requirement for merging is not needed, since when `size==1` the buttons acts as a "duplicate playlist" and there is nothing wrong with that.
You are not handling errors from these calls, and you should add them to `disposables` to make sure their lifetime is handled correctly
The text should not be hardcoded, create a string.
Why did you need to add this? Wouldn't `getOrderedStreamsOf` with `PlaylistStreamEntry` also work?

review_comment: What? Why are you inverting the check state each time the item is updated? The item is updated at times you can't control, try to see for example what happens if you have a long list where items do not fit in a single screen but you have to scroll through them. Search for how to handle multiselection in RecyclerViews.
